outcome_unknown.explanation: The record describes worsening. Follow-up is missing or too unclear to tell whether symptoms returned to their previous level.
outcome_unknown.label: Recovery unknown

permanent.explanation: The source explicitly describes a permanent decline from the earlier baseline.

persistent.explanation: Symptoms were still worse at the documented follow-up. Later recovery may be unknown.
persistent.label: Persistent at follow-up

recurrent.explanation: The patient described a similar worsening after more than one dose.
recurrent.label: Repeated with dosing

resolved_after_stopping.explanation: The reported symptom returned to its previous level after the patient stopped the intervention.

resolved_during_use.explanation: The reported symptom returned to its previous level while the patient continued taking the intervention.
resolved_during_use.label: Resolved during continued use

single_dose.explanation: The patient took one dose in this trial. Symptoms after that dose could be brief, prolonged or recurrent.
single_dose.label: One dose taken

single_episode.explanation: This account describes one episode. Its duration and the number of doses taken are separate questions.
single_episode.label: One recorded episode

time_limited.explanation: The report describes an episode that ended or gives its duration. The patient may have had other episodes.
time_limited.label: Episode ended

variable.explanation: The patient described different responses on separate dosing occasions.
variable.label: Varied between doses

held.explanation: The record documents a skipped dose, a pause or discontinuation. Recovery is recorded separately.
